Module com.example.masroofy_app
Package com.example.masroofy_app.model

Class BudgetCycle

java.lang.Object
com.example.masroofy_app.model.BudgetCycle
public class BudgetCycle extends Object
Represents a budget cycle for a user. It manages total allowance, remaining balance, start/end dates, and provides calculations for daily spending limits and validity checks.
